Task complete. Summary:

- **`out/T3/solution.py`**: loads `inputs/base/model.safetensors`, casts the 64 named projection weights (`attention.query_key_value.weight`, `attention.dense.weight`, `mlp.dense_h_to_4h.weight`, `mlp.dense_4h_to_h.weight` per layer) to bfloat16, upcasts every other kept tensor to float32, drops the 48 non-parameter buffers (`attention.bias`, `attention.masked_bias`, `attention.rotary_emb.inv_freq` per layer), runs the four required assertions before writing anything, then greedily bin-packs the 196 remaining tensors into shards capped at 256 MiB of tensor data (oversized tensors get their own shard) and writes `model-NNNNN-of-MMMMM.safetensors` files plus `model.safetensors.index.json`.
- Ran once, succeeded first try: 196 tensors across 9 shards. `embed_in.weight`/`embed_out.weight` land alone in shards 1–2 since upcasting them to float32 pushes each to ~393 MiB, over the 256 MiB budget — all other shards hold ~235–260 MiB each.
- Wrote `out/T3/REPORT.md` with the self-report, noting that pitfall (the embed tensors' oversized status only becomes apparent after the float32 upcast, not from the input's float16 size quoted in the task text).
